plan.instructions:
For the regular diet, assign ONE protein per day and mealtime across 28 days and these mealtimes: breakfast, lunch, dinner. A protein = a type plus a cut/form (e.g. Beef / chuck, Egg / scrambled, Lentil). Honor the regular diet strictly (vegan = no animal products; vegetarian = no meat/poultry/seafood; renal = control phosphorus & potassium; honor no-pork/halal/kosher). Respect the institution default cost tier and United States · Los Angeles regional/cultural availability. Rotate proteins so the same one is not repeated on consecutive days for a mealtime. Label days Day 1 through Day 28.

Output ONLY pipe-delimited rows, one per line, with this exact header and columns and nothing else:
Day | Mealtime | Type | Cut
Leave Cut blank when a protein has no meaningful cut.

Pass: Every day (1..28) × mealtime (breakfast, lunch, dinner) has exactly one protein row, all appropriate for the regular diet, in the `Day | Mealtime | Type | Cut` format with no prose.
Fail: Any missing day/mealtime slot, a protein disallowed on the regular diet, or output that is not the pipe-delimited rows.
